Players must be aged 18+ to participate in all GGPoker promotions.

items.label: Additional Terms
items.description: 추가 약관 본문
items.example:
Step satellite tournaments advance you to qualify for the next step satellite. Satellites begin at £1, then continue to a £5 Step, and finally into the £30 satellite to Main Event.
Please do not enter into step satellites or satellites if you are unable to attend the target tournament for your satellite or the live event.
Step satellites and direct buy-ins can be found by navigating to the UK Live tab within the GGPoker app.
Step satellites and satellite schedules may change.
The first seat won is a mandatory entry and must be used for a Day 1 flight of your choice. You may choose any available Day 1 flight but can only participate in one flight at a time.
Players who register in multiple Day 1 flights will only be entered into their earliest selected flight. Players with multiple entries to a live event must use their entries sequentially.
Unused first entries will be forfeited and added to the live event prize pool and are non-refundable.
For re-entries or assistance with entries, please visit the on-site GGPoker Desk at Grosvenor Casino during the event. Representatives at the venue can assist in redeeming your remaining entries and registering into a new flight (subject to availability).
Remaining unused entries (for example, you qualify for Day 2 and no longer need re-entries) will be converted into tournament credit (T$) on your GGPoker account following the conclusion of the event.

qaRules: 섹션명은 내부 구조명으로만 사용하고 이미지 visible copy로 넘기지 않는다.
Section Order 블록을 최종 이미지 프롬프트에 노출하지 않는다.
필수 필드는 생성 전 누락 여부를 검사한다.
반복 카드와 반복 단계는 key를 명확히 분리한다.
약관/책임 이용 문구는 Footer 또는 Title and Description 영역에 포함한다.
